results.text:

Selected items usually start in some geographic regions and then expand nationwide. ## Claims without prior authorization For items on the Required Prior Authorization List, prior authorization is a condition of payment. A claim submitted without an affirmative prior authorization decision, or without a provisional affirmation that meets the 90% compliance threshold, is not eligible for payment.

Standard requests are decided within 7 calendar days (effective January 1, 2025). Expedited requests are decided within 2 business days. Suppliers furnishing items under urgent circumstances can use specific modifiers, such as ST, to indicate an emergency, which may bypass the standard timelines.

results.title: CMS Policy Article A52467 - PAP devices, coding guidelines (companion to LCD L33718)
results.text:
# CPAP/PAP device coding guidelines and diagnosis requirements

## Overview

Positive airway pressure devices fall under the Durable Medical Equipment benefit category. For Medicare payment the equipment must meet the reasonable and necessary standard in the related Local Coverage Determination (L33718) and the specific statutory payment requirements.

## Diagnosis code requirements

The only diagnosis code that supports medical necessity for PAP therapy is G47.33 (obstructive sleep apnea). Having the code does not by itself guarantee coverage: the supplier must verify that all applicable coverage criteria in the LCD are met. ICD-10 codes other than G47.33 are treated as not supporting medical necessity for PAP devices, so other diagnoses cannot justify PAP claims.

## Device coding

results.title: CMS LCD L33718 - Positive Airway Pressure (PAP) devices for obstructive sleep apnea
results.text:
# Coverage indications for PAP devices in obstructive sleep apnea

## Initial Medicare coverage requirements

Three foundational criteria must be met. The item must fall within a defined Medicare benefit category. It must be reasonable and necessary for diagnosing or treating illness or injury or improving the function of a malformed body member. All other applicable statutory and regulatory requirements must be met.

The policy distinguishes E0601 (single-level continuous positive airway pressure, CPAP) from E0470 (bi-level respiratory assist device without backup rate). Both treat obstructive sleep apnea when specific conditions are documented.

final_text:
**Claim 1450749 is an outpatient claim. The model scores its denial risk low: probability_denied is 0.043, against a validation-set average of 0.1805.** That is 0.24 times the average, or -13.7 percentage points. The denial label in this project is synthetic. It was built from risk rules, so this score is not a real payer decision.

**What the model weighs**
- **HCPCS_CD 99408** is the main driver. It is documented as the procedure or service code billed. The model weighs it as lowering the odds of denial by 75%. That is a shift of -1.369 log-odds, from a baseline probability of 0.1404.
- **Small upward effects:** the principal diagnosis N186 (+5% odds), REV_CNTR_TOT_CHRG_AMT of 0.0 (+5%), LINE_PLACE_OF_SRVC_CD (+6%) and CARR_LINE_PRCNG_LCLTY_CD (+3%). The last three are not in the project data dictionary, so I can't say what they mean. All four values are NOT_APPLICABLE except the charge amount.
- **A small downward effect:** CARR_CLM_BLG_NPI_NUM (-8%) is also undocumented in the dictionary.
- **Not shown:** 153 features.
- **Unseen category:** the scorer flagged 1 category value in this claim as unseen in training. That makes the score somewhat less reliable.

**What to check before submitting**
The policy documents don't cover 99408 or N186. They cover the consultation-code rule, CPAP coverage and coding, and DMEPOS prior authorization, and none of the results applied to this claim. I can't give a policy-based checklist for it. Some general checks:
- Confirm the billed code and diagnosis match the record.
- Confirm the undocumented fields (place of service, billing NPI, pricing locality) are populated as intended.
- Find out which value was unseen.
- Confirm the zero charge amount is intended.
